facts.fact: Rory和Cora被Gabriel领进林中营地，空地上的塞拉夫士兵共五人——四男一女，全员皮甲佩武器，其中两人在营地两侧向外放哨。
facts.anchor: In the clearing stood a group of five, four men and one woman, all dressed in leathers with various weapons strapped to their bodies.

facts.fact: Gabriel向Rory和Cora介绍这五人是他最信任的士兵，并指着金发男子Dolus说他是自己的second in command（副指挥）；Dolus抬手致意、目光打量着两人。
facts.anchor: Gabriel gestured to the five imposing figures gawking at us. He stepped back to our side, placing a gentle hand on my shoulder.

facts.fact: Gabriel向士兵解释Rory和Cora在树林里遭dryad袭击、他及时赶到才未造成永久伤害，并补充说两人是从人类一侧意外穿过threshing wall进来的。
facts.anchor: They were attacked in the woods by a dryad. Thankfully, I heard the commotion before any permanent harm was done.

facts.fact: Gabriel命令Dolus给Rory和Cora弄吃的、其余士兵收营备马，决定当天带母女俩一起回城堡（须在日落前抵达）。
facts.anchor: These two have been through a harrowing couple of days and could use some food before I take them with us back to the castle.

facts.fact: Rory吃饭时偷听到女兵Devoruh与Jorus的交谈，拼凑出这支队伍正在侦察一伙企图劫走城堡在押囚犯的militia；士兵们发觉她在观察后谈话更谨慎。
facts.anchor: the group was on a reconnaissance mission to locate some militia who were thought to be plotting to break free criminals that were being imprisoned at the castle.

facts.fact: Cora回答Gabriel的骑马提问：她只跟妈妈骑过一次马、是逃离外婆家那次，那匹马叫Buttons；Gabriel没有追问，还提议她到城堡后上骑马课，Rory替女儿道谢应下。
facts.anchor: I rode a horse with my mom when we ran away from my grandmother. His name was Buttons. Does that count?

facts.fact: Rory内心坦白：她独自一人负担不起Cora的骑马课，母女俩当年逃难骑的那匹马也被她卖掉了。
facts.anchor: I had always wanted to share my love of horses with Cora, but I was never able to afford lessons for her on my own, and I sold the horse we escaped on.

facts.fact: Gabriel凭仪态和谈吐断定Rory是贵族出身；Rory承认自己在生下Cora后就离开了贵族生活，Gabriel表示不论血统都会保她安全，并说"once a noble, always a noble"。
facts.anchor: The way you carry yourself and speak. I can tell you have training and poise that are usually lacking in commoners. Am I wrong?

facts.fact: 原安排Cora与Devoruh同骑（备用马驮补给），Rory提出异议后Devoruh抱怨浪费时间，Gabriel手指着她脸警告再抗命就送她去atoner受罚，Devoruh只得卸货重分补给；最终Gabriel把Cora抱放到Rory身前的dapple-grey母马鞍上，并请Cora为这匹无名母马取名。
facts.anchor: This human is named Rory, and she and her daughter just went through a traumatic event and wish not to be separated. Their needs are never a waste of time.
